onboarding.notes: Brownfield onboarding completed on 2026-10-18. A baseline constitution (v1.0.0) was generated from repository facts, with a security baseline that expands only the controls that apply to a Next.js + Convex + Clerk stack. Four retroactive specs document shipped behaviour; they are marked retroactive in their spec.md frontmatter, in overview.assumptions, and in this onboarding block, and they are not approved product decisions. The raw scan remains in .sdrive/onboarding/inventory.json and report.md. Two framework inconsistencies were found: (1) onboard.js writes onboarding.projectBrief, which workflow-state.schema.json rejects, so that key was removed and the brief is preserved in .sdrive/product/overview.md and .sdrive/onboarding/decisions.md; (2) the retroactive marker is kept out of governance JSON because spec.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false, and the validator is run via .sdrive/onboarding/validate.js because the root node_modules resolves Ajv 6 while SpecDrive requires Ajv 8. Current quality gate: npx tsc --noEmit passes and npm run lint passes with 0 errors and 14 warnings after the follow-up fix (ignore .sdrive/** and convex/_generated/** in the flat config; defer the carousel's initial select), so all verification tasks and quality NFRs are complete. The product overview was approved on 2026-10-18 through the onboarding interview: it is organizer-first and global, and the Nigeria-first implementation (NG pickers, naira pricing, seed cities) is recorded as an implementation gap rather than the product boundary.
